//: Content for ui/pet/core/40-zzz-the-recycle-stash.js: each key is a CONTENT("key") there. tools/build_petcore.py puts it into petcore.js;
"//" keys are notes and are left out. Times are in milliseconds (a minute 60000, an hour 3600000, a day 86400000).
minutes: a lot takes this many minutes for each tier of the thing (its gem tier, at least 1): old boots 30 min, bronze 1 h, iron 1 h 30, steel 2 h ... (Cam, I4, 2026-10-19)
speed: the stash, tier 1-4: how long it takes against tier 1 (a better stash is quicker)
kinds: the recycled materials store, tier 1-4: kinds of material it holds
share: what comes back of what went into it
lots: lots in the stash at once
